sharedStoryClusters.story: French Unrest and Curfews Imposed in Paris and Nice
sharedStoryClusters.summary: Following severe nationwide riots, looting, and widespread arrests over living costs, French authorities implemented localized nighttime curfews across major cities including Paris, Marseille, and Nice. Outlets highlight extensive business property damage, a French 10-year bond yield hitting 5% for the first time since 2002, and ongoing tourist disruptions amid political debates.
sharedStoryClusters.developmentNote: France 24 reports partial nighttime curfews enacted across Paris and Nice following widespread riots.
